# Item: ExecC1SuiteBuild

You build the COMPLETE, committed-ready draft of the new instrument `corpus/instruments/r37-closure.sh` as a full file block in your receipt (the L1 lands it byte-identically). - Bash, `set -uo pipefail`, export-mode only: `--export-ref <hash>` extracts the named lane head via `git -C <lane> archive <hash> | tar -x -C <scratch>/export` and every check reads ONLY bytes under that export root; a plain run (no flags) refuses with exit 2. `--selftest` runs positive+mutant limbs (see below). `--work`/`--lane`/`--scratch-root` overrides, work-dir guards (never inside the lane; stale export/mut cleared before use), cleanup trap on exit, `suite_digest()` printing the sha256 of the executing bytes.
- Fourteen checks E1-E14 (semantics from the frozen claim, schema above): E1-E9 as in r36-closure.sh but E9 rewritten fail-closed — a `git -C <lane> status --porcelain` read that FAILS (nonzero exit, empty output) must print `status-read=failed` and close that limb as RED; NEVER default to 0 dirty lines (no `${porcelain:-0}`, no `2>/dev/null` on the status read). E10 validates `.ufo/waves/round-37/final-gates/all-gates.txt` in the export: contains `suite-sha256=<digest>` where digest equals the suite's own `suite_digest()`; contains ≥14 `E<n> payload=` lines; contains `closed=14/14 exit=0`; contains ≥14 `selftest case=` lines and `cases=14 failures=0`. E11 greps the LOG.md round-37 block for a named correction of the false `r36-fixtures/` path. E12 greps round-37 lesson + round-37 SCORECARD section for `anchor ancestor` + `c20300df` and asserts `Final lane commit: e666d902` is absent inside the round-37 SCORECARD section. E13 asserts the SKILL.md gates & probes registry row `r36-closure.sh` has a single-choice type cell (not the literal `gate|probe`) and its verdict map contains `could-not-evaluate`. E14 shape-check: `grep -cF 'porcelain:-0' r37-closure.sh` -> 0 and no `2>/dev/null` on status reads.
- `--selftest` prints one `selftest case=E<n> positive=... mutants=<ok>/<n> verdict=...` line per check (14 cases), then `selftest cases=14 failures=0`; exit 0 only when all 14 ran, all positives passed, all mutants rejected. Summary-only forgery (cases=0 failures=0) must NOT satisfy it.
- Do NOT create the file in the lane: put the complete script text in your receipt (plus in scratch). Include sha256 of your draft and `bash -n` result. If a part cannot be finalized without the other seats' inputs, still deliver your best complete draft and say what you assumed.
